composition_elements.framing: flat front-facing screen capture with a fictional desktop on the left and browser window occupying the right two-thirds

technical_specs.finish: realistic skin and fabric, clean cursor edge, restrained screen noise, and no CGI gloss

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a surreal digital-art composition integrated into a photorealistic fictional desktop screenshot. Show a clearly adult woman with short dark hair, a contemplative expression, and natural skin texture, wearing a black strapless fashion top and long flowing black skirt. From a front-facing screen view, make her appear to float gently out of a fictional browser search-results panel, with her relaxed arms hanging naturally and her torso leaning slightly forward. A white arrow-shaped cursor touches a small fabric edge behind her as a playful graphic illusion, with a soft shadow and no injury, restraint, or dangerous suspension. Place a fictional browser window over the right two-thirds of a blue-and-purple abstract desktop with generic icons on the left, fictional tabs, address bar, search field, results, and bottom taskbar. Do not use Windows, Chrome, Google, real URLs, real account data, or real application logos. Use diffused screen-cast light, clean UI edges, realistic fabric, and photoreal composite integration.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, injury, hanging, strangulation, dangerous restraint, real operating system, real browser logo, real search engine, real URL, personal data, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed limbs, broken cursor, unreadable UI
